exposure: intermittent pneumatic compression of lower limbs
cohort: 76 non-laboring parturient patients aged 18-45 years, with American Society of Anesthesiologist physical status I or II, scheduled for elective cesarean section
finding: Intermittent pneumatic compression of the lower limbs was associated with reduced hypotension and lower vasopressor requirements after spinal anesthesia for cesarean section.
